title: Square Root of Small Integers
content:
Having decimal approximations of the square roots of small integers memorized is beneficial for estimation problems.

  • $\sqrt{2} \approx 1.414$
  • $\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732$
  • $\sqrt{5} \approx 2.236$
  • $\sqrt{6} \approx 2.449$
  • $\sqrt{7} \approx 2.645$
  • $\sqrt{8} \approx 2.828$
summary: Having decimal approximations of the square roots of small integers memorized is beneficial for estimation problems.
